brief:
Jerusalem District Electricity Company announced it will cut power from 8 a.m. to 1:30 p.m. on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, the Ma'an news agency reported. The outage will affect portions of Ramallah and Al-Bireh governorate, though the company said it regretted the necessity of the measure.

The company did not specify the reason for the planned outage in the announcement.

title: Jerusalem electricity company cuts power across Ramallah areas Tuesday
